title: Reflexive Pronouns
description: myself / yourself / himself / herself / itself / ourselves / yourselves / themselves

explain.ta: Reflexive pronouns என்பது செயலை செய்பவரே அதன் பலனையும் பெறுவதைக் குறிக்கும். இவை -self அல்லது -selves என முடியும். I → myself, you → yourself/yourselves, he → himself, she → herself, it → itself, we → ourselves, they → themselves. உதாரணம்: 'I hurt myself' (நான் என்னையே காயப்படுத்திக்கொண்டேன்).
explain.en: Reflexive pronouns show that the subject does the action to itself. They end in -self or -selves. I → myself, you → yourself/yourselves, he → himself, she → herself, it → itself, we → ourselves, they → themselves. Example: 'I hurt myself' means I hurt me, the same person.

examples.en: She looked at herself in the mirror.
We enjoyed ourselves at the party.

masteryQuestions.promptEn: Did you enjoy ___ at the concert?
